name: Lissandra
notes: The opening cast is Frozen Tomb (R) used on the dummy (enemy-cast) since its long cooldown means it is realistically cast once per fight; its magic damage is modeled as landing when the 0.375 s cast completes, since the ice field originates at the target and the target itself needs no time to be reached by the spreading field.

Ice Shard (Q) is cast on cooldown for the whole fight; its damage is dealt on cast rather than after a separate missile-travel delay, matching how the reference drivers treat short-range instant abilities.
Ring of Frost (W) has no cast time, so it is cast the instant it comes off cooldown and never locks out an attack.

Glacial Path (E) is cast on cooldown for its damage, then recast 0.5 s later purely because both casts count as separate ability activations for on-cast effects (Spellblade, Muramana); the recast (blink) itself deals no damage. Its cooldown starts at the initial cast, not the recast, per the wiki.
Iceborn Subjugation (P) only spawns a Frozen Thrall when a nearby enemy champion dies; the stationary dummy never dies, so it never triggers and is omitted from the kit.
Frozen Tomb's self-cast (stasis + missing-health heal) is purely defensive and is never used; only the enemy-cast, which deals damage, is modeled.
Mana is not modeled: Lissandra's level-16 mana pool comfortably covers a cooldown-capped rotation across a 15 s fight.
Lissandra has no on-hit or attack-reset component, so basic attacks (using the base attack stats) simply fill any gaps between casts with no kit modifiers.
